title: Custom Widget
description: FuseDash CustomWidget shell — title, optional KPI band, and up to two arranged panes. Chart panes mount ui9000-chart-renderer, the KPI band mounts ui9000-kpi-widget, table/text/image panes mount those primitives. No Redux.

usageConditions.requiresArranging: Reads arranging.widgets / arranging.hasKpi / arranging.direction; renders the default state when both are absent.

data.description: FuseDash WidgetItem JSON for the custom widget, including arranging, kpis, and pane fields (text, imageUrl, headers, tableData, tablePreviewRows)

chartType.description: Chart type of the chartWidget pane; content types (tableChart, textChart, imageChart) render the pane empty state

text.description: Markdown/plain text for a textWidget pane

imageUrl.description: http(s) URL for an imageWidget pane

headers.description: Table columns. Each contains[].source is dataset | chart | static

tablePreviewRows.description: MCP snapshot used as dataset rows when the host has no live select

direction.description: FuseDash semantics — vertical lays panes side by side, horizontal stacks them

kpis.description: KPI items rendered in the KPI band when arranging.hasKpi is true

chartTitle.description: Header title override; falls back to data.name
